Show group protection with one complete oval circle and a sheltering arc of light. Painterly oil/gouache treatment, broad readable shapes, convincing warm metal and luminous material, dark blue-black full-bleed atmospheric background, controlled gold-white light, tiny silhouettes remain legible at 32 pixels. Match the project's approved magical family in spirit: strong subject, broad silhouette, textured material and dramatic directional glow like a painted shield resisting fire. Composition is clearly a larger group ward, unlike an ordinary single-person Protection shield. No text, letters, UI frame, decorative square border, silver-dust ritual, binding diagram, chained prisoner, summoned monster, attack, or red prohibition slash. Important: this is one original standalone icon, not a grid, sprite sheet, screenshot, or a finished game UI. Fill a square image and keep all meaningful forms within the middle 85 percent.
